items.title: Revolution Medicines Wins FDA Approval for Pancreatic Cancer Pill. What It Means for the Stock.
items.summary: Daraxonrasib, the pill touted by a former member of Congress and cancer patient as a ‘miracle drug,’ has been granted approval in patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma.

items.title: Has AbbVie Stock Become Too Expensive to Buy?
items.summary: The drugmaker's stock is on a tear, but for investors arriving now, the real question is whether the business can outrun its own premium price.

items.title: How Much Upside Is Left in JNJ Stock?
items.summary: While the market fixates on the STELARA patent cliff, the rest of the story is being missed. That drug now represents a small fraction of the Innovative Medicine portfolio. The remaining 96% of that business is posting remarkable growth, expanding at over 14.

items.title: Moderna Drops 7% Despite a Fresh Wolfe Research Upgrade, BioNTech Slips
items.summary: Moderna stock shed 7% on Wednesday with no company news to blame, reopening a brutal question that its 439% year-to-date rally had been drowning out: what exactly does a $59 billion valuation buy on a revenue base this thin?

items.title: Merck Stock Hits New 52-Week High: What's Driving the Rally?
items.summary: MRK hits a 52-week high as positive melanoma data, pipeline progress, new launches and M&A bolster its long-term growth outlook.

items.title: Can Eli Lilly Stock Keep Surging As Drug Prices Fall?
items.summary: The past year's gain was bought with volume and access, and management has already said net price goes lower from here.

items.title: Why Did RUM, MRK, NEM Stocks Jump To 52-Week Highs Today?
items.summary: Rum Group, Merck, and Newmont shares surged to annual highs amid positive company catalysts, Wall Street optimism, and a rise in gold prices.

items.title: MRNA Stock Jumps 14% Past $150 As Wolfe Sees $9.2B Cancer-Vaccine Opportunity
items.summary: The optimism around MRNA began last week after Moderna and partner Merck reported that their personalized cancer vaccine, intismeran, met key goals in a late-stage study for high-risk melanoma.
